note: 不正常 fixture: 適用対象の行に証跡も follow_up もない。証跡のない適用対象を黙って省略する経路を fail closed にする（not run にすらできない）。

standard.name: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard
standard.note: A fixture ledger. It is not an ASVS certification or an audit.

manifest.policy: Every selected applicable requirement names a control and evidence; missing evidence is not run with follow_up and is never a pass.

items.requirement: Verify that responses include an enforcing Content-Security-Policy header field.
